parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-generated key (e.g. a UUID v4) that makes a retried request safe (ADR-0027). Required on every POST: the service runs on Postgres in every deployment (ADR-0038) and rejects a request without it with 400 idempotency-key-required. Reuse the SAME key for retries of one logical request (same body) — the first response, success or business error, is stored and replayed byte-for-byte for the key's TTL (24h by default) — and a NEW key for each new logical request. Reusing a key with a different request (method, path or body) is rejected with 409 idempotency-key-reused. A key that is not 1-128 printable ASCII characters is a 400 idempotency-key-invalid. Every POST of this service takes the key; the key is global (looked up by key alone), so one key must never be reused across routes.
